title: AIGIS
description: An open-source AI governance CLI, published on npm and PyPI with 6,000+ downloads and an endorsement from a former Washington Post CTO. One command compiles a plain-English project description into a deterministic governance brief mapped against NIST AI RMF, OWASP Top 10 for LLMs, and ISO/IEC 42001. Built for the coding-agent era: governance content structured for AI agents first, humans second.

title: Tokenomics
description: Tokenomics is a token-aware optimization and memory layer that sits between your application and LLM providers. It decides, per query, whether to answer from cache, compress the prompt, or route to the cheapest model that can do the job. Benchmarked at ~90% LLM API cost reduction with quality preserved, combining semantic caching, UCB bandit routing, prompt compression, and cascading inference.

title: AdVantage Ecosystem
description:
Driving a New Era of Learning with Peer-to-Peer Collaboration and Community Innovation
Advantage Ecosystem is a next-generation educational platform designed to foster decentralized, peer-to-peer learning networks. Our mission is to make education more engaging, inclusive, and practical by creating a dynamic ecosystem where students, professionals, and communities collaborate seamlessly.

title: The Solaris Mission (Community + Podcast)
description: The Society for Outer Life and Advanced Research on Interstellar Settlements: a space-science community exploring astronomy, outer life, and interstellar settlement through a podcast, blog, and community content.

title: Veritas RAG
description: A portable, local-first RAG retrieval engine that packages your knowledge into a shippable “retrieval artifact” for fast, offline, privacy-preserving search (no vector DB, no server).
